   200→    transition:all 0.3s;
   201→  }
   202→  .skill-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
   203→  .skill-cat{
   204→    font-family:'Cairo',sans-serif;font-weight:700;
   205→    color:var(--accent);font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:20px;
   206→    padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
   207→  }
   208→  .skill-item{margin-bottom:12px;}
   209→  .skill-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:5px;}
   210→  .skill-name{color:var(--text);font-size:0.95rem;}
   211→  .skill-level{color:var(--text-2);font-size:0.85rem;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}
   212→  .skill-bar{
   213→    width:100%;height:6px;background:var(--bg);
   214→    border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;
   215→  }
   216→  .skill-fill{
   217→    height:100%;border-radius:3px;
   218→    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
   219→    transition:width 1s ease;
   220→  }
   221→
   222→  /* ===== PROJECTS ===== */
   223→  .projects-grid{display:grid;gap:30px;}
   224→  .project-card{
   225→    background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);
   226→    border-radius:16px;padding:30px;
   227→    transition:all 0.3s;display:grid;
   228→    grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr;gap:30px;
   229→    align-items:start;
   230→  }
   231→  @media(max-width:768px){.project-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
   232→  .project-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
   233→  .project-badge{
   234→    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
   235→    color:var(--bg);padding:15px;border-radius:12px;
   236→    text-align:center;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
   237→    font-weight:700;
   238→  }
   239→  .project-badge .num{font-size:2rem;display:block;}
   240→  .project-badge .label{font-size:0.8rem;opacity:0.85;}
   241→  .project-title{
   242→    font-family:'Cairo',sans-serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:700;
   243→    color:var(--text);margin-bottom:5px;
   244→  }
   245→  .project-subtitle{
   246→    color:var(--accent);font-size:0.9rem;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
   247→    margin-bottom:15px;
   248→  }
   249→  .project-desc{color:var(--text-2);margin-bottom:15px;font-size:0.95rem;}
   250→  .project-features{list-style:none;margin-bottom:15px;}
   251→  .project-features li{
   252→    padding-right:25px;position:relative;
   253→    color:var(--text);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:6px;
   254→  }
   255→  .project-features li::before{
   256→    content:'▸';position:absolute;right:0;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;
   257→  }
   258→  .tech-stack{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
   259→  .tech-tag{
   260→    background:var(--bg);color:var(--accent);
   261→    padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;
   262→    font-size:0.8rem;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
   263→    border:1px solid var(--accent);
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  /* ===== AlMoutmag Special Card ===== */
   267→  .project-card.almoutmag-card{
   268→    --almoutmag-logo-img:url('data:image/png;base64,');
   269→    position:relative;
   270→    overflow:hidden;
   271→    grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;
   272→    border:1px solid transparent;
   273→    background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(10,22,40,0.92) 0%,rgba(17,34,64,0.95) 100%);
   274→  }
   275→  .project-card.almoutmag-card::before{
   276→    content:'';
   277→    position:absolute;
   278→    inset:0;
   279→    background-image:var(--almoutmag-logo-img);
   280→    background-size:cover;
   281→    background-position:center;
   282→    background-repeat:no-repeat;
   283→    opacity:0.18;
   284→    z-index:0;
   285→  }
   286→  .project-card.almoutmag-card > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
   287→  .project-card.almoutmag-card:hover{
   288→    border-color:#4ade80;
   289→    transform:translateY(-5px);
   290→    box-shadow:0 20px 60px -10px rgba(74,222,128,0.4);
   291→  }
   292→  .almoutmag-card .project-badge{
   293→    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4ade80 0%,#22d3ee 100%);
   294→    color:#0a1628;
   295→  }
   296→  .almoutmag-card .project-title{
   297→    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4ade80 0%,#22d3ee 50%,#a855f7 100%);
   298→    -webkit-background-clip:text;
   299→    -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
   300→    background-clip:text;
   301→  }
   302→  .almoutmag-logo{
   303→    width:160px;
   304→    height:160px;
   305→    margin:20px auto;
   306→    background-image:var(--almoutmag-logo-img);
   307→    background-size:contain;
   308→    background-repeat:no-repeat;
   309→    background-position:center;
   310→    filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(74,222,128,0.5));
   311→    border-radius:12px;
   312→  }
   313→  /* AlMoutmag — mobile fix: the card's own selector (.project-card.almoutmag-card)
   314→     has higher specificity than the base @media rule, so without this override
   315→     the card would keep its 200px badge column and break on phones */
   316→  @media(max-width:768px){
   317→    .project-card.almoutmag-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
   318→    .almoutmag-logo{width:120px;height:120px;margin:15px auto;}
   319→  }
